forum.title: In STM32 Cube IDE code is not generated for whatever board I select.
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@Rahul Garg

I was not able to reproduce the behavior described while using **STM32CubeIDE 1.19**.

The project was well created and generated with **STM32L476RGTx.**

I recommend that you check your network connection and install the relevant firmware before generating the code.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/e0c6c99d-ade3-4b35-a8f7-da77e19c7a54.png)

Thanks.

Mahmoud
forum.content_text:
I am following these steps :-

Create STM32 Project

File → New → STM32 Project

Select STM32L476RGTx (LQFP64) MCU/board → Next → Finish

Open the .ioc file

Configure LED1

In Pinout & Configuration,

Set PA2 to GPIO\_Output, then click on project → generate code ( The ‘main.c’ file is not generate for given MCU and also for other MCU for similar steps code is not generating).

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/0ebe88e5-ecc9-45a0-adf2-2e3dad56b915.png)![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/8f760126-8cf2-4774-b215-08608eee7f0e.png)![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/c61b2121-35f1-4d42-a360-4294015a4e27.png)![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/32ffafeb-4eed-43ac-bd4d-77c6483d9a19.png)![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/cd6e1d77-a422-4eeb-b7ae-2173272bb1e6.png)![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/7b0a7e4f-57ca-4124-8dc7-eea5b535d6c9.png)![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/30aa4c2a-a159-429d-a454-3cc1ebc71c12.png)![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/e6a56b7d-febe-4e0d-9ae1-3aa7a3ab2dad.png)
